cr_data.provenance: Georgia O’Keeffe (1887–1986), Abiquiú, NM [on loan to the Art Institute of Chicago from 1971]; partially sold and partially given to the Art Institute of Chicago, 1983. (Source: Art Institute of Chicago website, 2025)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive after 1969 indicates [by Lloyd Goodrich], ". . . Doris Bry told me 4/8/70 that the correct title is Sky Above Clouds,  / and the date is 1965." Downtown Gallery Archive dates 1966; Abiquiú Notebooks dates 1965. Dated 1965 on basis of inclusion in 1966 exhibition. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

description: Ovular, semiabstract white clouds fill the frame in orderly horizontal lines. As the clouds recede into the distance, they become smaller. The forms contrast with the blue sky beneath, which meets a pale pink horizon line at the upper third of the composition. The pink fades into pale blue near the top of the canvas.
